findings.finding: Checklist snapshots, decisions/reasons/notes are server-persisted contracts; GET checklist comes from payload
All completion flags use global localStorage and result.id + name, no account/item/revision identity
Same-name items can share completion; changed content under same result/name can inherit old mark
Shared browser storage is not account-private; logout does not clear docsDone; two-tab whole-map writes can overwrite
Existing tenancy is organization scope; per-user marks require principal-derived actor key, not client user_id
No stable item/revision/completed field in DocumentItem/Checklist; generated_at is fresh generation time
One progress sidecar for existing checklist self-marks, principal/result/revision/item_ref, absolute done state plus stale-write guard

execution: Static source reads and stdlib hash/report packaging only; no app import or runtime validation
limitations: No user or applicant data inspected
No entire planner or source patch
lookup_history: Initial guessed db/API subdirectory names did not exist; corrected using actual models/API file inventory. No product execution or source failure.
